action.label: Prepare for your internship
action.title: Get ready for your first day
action.body: Review your onboarding requirements and make sure your information is up to date before the internship begins.

project.title: Cybersecurity Threat Analysis
project.description: Interns will conduct structured threat analysis and develop automated threat intelligence pipelines for defence networks. Scope includes threat modelling using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, malware behavioural analysis, and development of detection rules for SIEM platforms. Learning outcomes include adversarial thinking and practical cyber defence workflows. Deliverables include threat reports, SIEM detection rule sets, and a documented threat modelling framework.

action.label: Completion action required
action.title: Complete your offboarding
action.body: Submit the required internship feedback to complete your record. You can also build a resume entry, prepare a LinkedIn post and track certificate eligibility.

Dear Jenny,

Welcome to the University Internship 2026 programme. You will be joining the Cybersecurity Threat Analysis project under the guidance of Wei Jian Lim.

Please review your onboarding information and report to the DSTA Digital Hub on 23 June 2026.

Regards,
DSTA Internship Office
